newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: British extradition target detained by Irish court.
newsitem.headline: British extradition target detained by Irish court.

text.p: A special criminal court in Dublin on Wednesday charged British extradition target Nessun Quinlivan with falsely imprisoning a man and ordered him to be remanded in custody for four weeks.
A second man, John Ryan, was also detained for four weeks on the same charge.
Quinlivan was last year released on bail by the Irish High Court pending an appeal against British attempts to extradite him.
He escaped from London's Brixton prison in 1991 along with Pearse McAuley while awaiting trial on charges of conspiracy to murder and cause explosions.
The two men fled to Ireland where they were jailed on firearms charges until their release last year.
Britain said Quinlivan and McAuley were suspected of involvement in an Irish Republican Army plot to murder brewing tycoon Sir Charles Tidbury.
The IRA is fighting to end British rule of Northern Ireland.
